title: Lior and the Extraction
author: Hazel Montrose
blurb: Cyrus Winterbourne, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
